Sam: quick heads-up — planning a mixed percent+region canary for model_v7 tomorrow morning. want to confirm slices and abort conditions.
Jaime: what slices are you thinking? region-first or percent-across-all?
Sam: leaning region-first in NA then EU, but a tiny global percent for internal beta. proposal: NA 5% -> EU 3% -> global internal 0.5% -> ramp further if green.
Mohit: +1 region-first. recommend start NA only at 1% for first 30m then 5% if metrics stable. EU can follow after NA 1h.
Taylor: can we automate the schedule? i can add a ramp job in the console. want explicit steps so rollout is reproducible.
Sam: yeah, schedule like: NA: 1% -> 5% (30m gap), EU: 1% -> 3% (1h after NA reach), internal-global: 0.5% continuous. abort if any signal trips.
Jaime: define signals pls: error-rate jump, latency regression, safety flags, and quality regressions on smoke prompts.
Mohit: propose thresholds:
- 5xx rate increase > 0.25 percentage points absolute OR relative > 2x
- p95 latency increase > 200ms absolute
- quality regressions: automated eval delta > 3% on pinned prompt set
- safety classifier alerts > 0.1% of requests
Sam: ok add these to the toggle runbook. also include customer-impact cutoff: if >0.5% of paid requests see errors, abort and rollback immediately.
Taylor: i'll add runbook sections and create grafana panels tagged `canary/model_v7`
Taylor: i'll also create a smoke test job against the canary slice that runs the 50 core prompts every 10m.
Jaime: who will trigger the initial toggle? devex or runtime oncall?
Sam: i'll do the manual enable for the NA 1% step, then the scheduled ramp will take over. @Mohit pls check the feature-flag constraints in the API before tomorrow.
Mohit: will run a dry-run now. quick commands for visibility:
```
# set slices (dry-run)
redwood toggle plan set model_v7_mix --slices "na:1,eu:0,global_internal:0.5" --dry-run
# schedule ramp
redwood ramp schedule model_v7_mix --steps "na:1,na:5,eu:1,eu:3" --intervals "30m,30m,60m"
```
Sam: nice. include an audit tag `canary_2026-03-18` so we can filter logs.
Mohit: dry-run output looks good — no validation errors. leaving comments in the PR for the ramp job.
deploy-bot: scheduled job created: ramp/model_v7_mix by Taylor — next step NA -> 1% at 2026-03-18T09:00:00Z
Taylor: confirm i'll push the dashboard link and the smoke job. will also add the automatic rollback hook using these cutoff thresholds.
Jaime: add an escalation matrix to the runbook — who to call if rollback fails (oncall + eng leads)
Sam: added names to runbook draft in the doc. final ask: keep canary duration minimal, prefer narrower slices if any instability.
Mohit: +1. i'll monitor during the window and post interim checks here every 15m.
Taylor: thanks — i'll post the dashboard links and the smoke job logs in this thread when they're live.
Sam: cool, thanks everyone. ping @deploy-bot when the first step actually starts so we have a timestamped event.
deploy-bot: toggle update: model_v7_mix state=enabled slice=na:1 (initiated by Sam) — ts=2198766000
Mohit: saw the initial metrics spike; p95 up 30ms, error-rate steady. continuing to observe.
Taylor: smoke job passed first run. posting dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/abc123/model_v7_canary
Jaime: copy. i'll keep an eye on eval deltas and safety logs.
Sam: excellent. if anything looks off we abort at once. otherwise we'll proceed to NA 5% in 30m.
Mohit: next status update at +15m.
